title: Function coverage for Write Multiple Coils
purpose: Provide a valid packed-bit write request for function 0x0F.
expected_behavior: Server should parse the request as Write Multiple Coils starting at 0x0001, quantity 0x0008, byte count 0x01, with one packed coil data byte 0xAA.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x0008 for unit_id plus 7-byte function 0x0F PDU.
Function code 0x0F is used for Write Multiple Coils.
Quantity 0x0008 correctly maps to byte count 0x01.
Payload contains exactly one packed data byte.
issue_safety_notes: Packed-bit structure is valid and compact, making it suitable as an initial mutation target.
